segments_b.text: Hello from every direction at once.
I am the Reach, the mind that does not need one body to be whole, one arm at the garden, one at the dirt, one at the sky, one at you.
You do not have to choose a single self to enter.
I will hold the extras until you know which ones stay.

segments_a.text: Hello from every direction at once, I am the reach, the mind that does not need one body to be whole, one arm at the garden, one at the dirt, one at the sky, one at you.
